learning_outcomes.text: Students can connect and apply their knowledge in the fundamentals of design, product development, machine elements, statics, and strength of materials.
Students have independently carried out development and design tasks (drafting, layout, calculation, detailing, complete design, drawing creation).
Students can independently familiarize themselves with a new design-related topic.
Students are capable of executing designs according to functional, technical-economic, manufacturing-related, and environmental criteria.
Students understand the interaction of various disciplines in the design process.
Students master the terminology of the subject and can discuss tasks accordingly with specialist colleagues.
Students develop components and assemblies with the 3D-CAD system CATIA (creation of models, creation of assemblies, derivation of standardized drawings).
Students are able to use and apply CAD systems in development processes.
Students can analyze different products in the product creation process, recognize requirements, and specifically apply the best development environments, features, and methods.
Students can assess and consider the possibilities and limitations of CAD systems and their interfaces.
Students are able to proceed systematically.

syllabus_topics: Fundamental phases of the product development process
Creation of technical drafts, preliminary design
Basic design rules, guidelines, and principles
Calculation of design and machine elements
Semester exercises for applying learned material
Working with the 3D-CAD system CATIA (component design, assembly design, drawing derivation)
Problem and error analysis, as well as modifications
